text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today marks the end of our time at the summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Man, time sure flies. It feels like we just got here yesterday.
choice_data_list: That means you got a lot out of it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Then I guess this summer camp was totally worth it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: And it'll be time for the Kikuka Sho race before we know it. I gotta keep up the momentum after we get back!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: There's no time to waste for you either! I need your full cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Here we come! The Kikuka Sho won't know what hit it!
